title: Bound on padded-clone failure probability
statement: Let $V$ be a set on which equality is decidable, and let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template. For natural numbers $r,M$ with $0<M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. The probability that a padded clone occurrence fails to have an injective padded clone scope is at most $r^2/M$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
